thread:
sofia: Heads-up - product approved another EOL extension for Legacy SDK (2.x/3.x). New EOL: 2026-12-31.
sofia: We're publishing a migration playbook and delaying hard redirects in docs until the playbook is live.
raj: Quick context: several enterprise customers requested more runway; this keeps us aligned with sales/CS ask.
lee: Engineering summary: we'll introduce a temporary "legacy-compat" flag in SDK v4.x to reduce churn. Its opt-in and guarded behind a feature flag.
harper: CS: we'll push targeted outreach to customers with >$5k/mo usage. Need sample messaging and a one-pager.
migrator-bot: release: redwood-migrator v1.0.0-alpha  run `redwood-migrate --report` to get suggested diffs. https://internal.redwood.dev/migrator
sofia: Docs plan (high level): 1) migration playbook with step-by-step patches and roll-back guidance 2) compat flag reference + perf caveats 3) CLI quickstart and sample PRs 4) public FAQ blurb and Support KB. ETA: playbook draft 2026-05-15.
lee: Engineering will ship the compat flag behind `REDWOOD_COMPAT=true` env and expose a `compat` option on the Client constructor. Will not restore deprecated telemetry or historical sampling.
sofia: Example snippet for docs (draft):
```
# python example
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), compat={"enabled": True})
# CLI scan
redwood-migrate --scan --target sdk3 --out migration-report.md
```
sofia: Note: call out perf impact (~5-12% on small batch sizes). We'll add microbench numbers.
harper: I'll draft the CS outreach: short email + migration checklist + offer for white-glove migration for top 20 accounts.
raj: Public messaging should emphasize: "We're providing extra time and tooling to make migrations smooth. Compatibility helper is temporary." Add link to FAQ and schedule for removal.
deployment-bot: docs staging site updated: https://staging.docs.redwood.dev/migration-playbook (staging token required).
sofia: Action items: - Sofia: post playbook draft + sample PRs by 2026-05-15 - Lee: compat flag PR by 2026-04-20 - Eng: add opt-in telemetry label `compat_flag=true` (no payloads) by 2026-04-25 - Harper: outreach plan + templates by 2026-05-01
harper: Also adding support runbooks for common blockers: auth header differences, timeout/streaming behavior, regional endpoints.
lee: For on-prem/private installs: compat flag will be in the next release but customers may need manual patches; escalate to eng-infra if they need bundles.
sofia: Once playbook is live, we'll remove redirect warnings and replace with a banner linking to migration docs for clarity.
raj: Let's align on the public EOL page copy before we announce externally. Put draft here and I'll iterate.
sofia: Draft public blurb: "We are extending the deprecation timeline for Legacy SDKs to Dec 31, 2026. To help customers migrate were providing an opt-in compatibility mode and a migration CLI. See our migration playbook for details and contact support for assistance."
harper: small edit: add "temporary" before compatibility mode and mention targeted outreach.
sofia: Updated. I'll schedule the #general announcement after docs and CS templates are ready.
lee: FYI: compat_flag will emit metrics to `redwood.compat.flag` metric namespace only when explicitly enabled. No payload telemetry.
sofia: Thanks all, closing the loop. Please drop any customer-facing wording suggestions or edge-case notes here. :pray:
